HADESANCIENTS-BLOOD_SPREE.title: Blood Spree
HADESANCIENTS-BLOOD_SPREE.description: Upon pickup, obtain [gold]Charon's Obol[/gold]. When you encounter the Merchant, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] Gold and lose [red]{MaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP.
HADESANCIENTS-BLOOD_SPREE.flavor: A sacrifice in blood is fully paid, and we are squared away.
HADESANCIENTS-GRIEVOUS_BLOW.title: Grievous Blow
HADESANCIENTS-GRIEVOUS_BLOW.description: Every [blue]3rd[/blue] Attack you play deals double damage.
HADESANCIENTS-GRIEVOUS_BLOW.flavor: I shall empower you to acts of greater violence than before.
HADESANCIENTS-GRISLY_GAIN.title: Grisly Gain
HADESANCIENTS-GRISLY_GAIN.description: Every [blue]4th[/blue] Attack you play from your [gold]Hand[/gold] is free.
HADESANCIENTS-GRISLY_GAIN.flavor: Perhaps my blessing shall let you deliver death still more efficiently.
HADESANCIENTS-MEAT_GRINDER.title: Meat Grinder
HADESANCIENTS-MEAT_GRINDER.description: Whenever you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies twice.
HADESANCIENTS-MEAT_GRINDER.flavor: May you sow such destruction as to shake this mountain to its core, my kin.
HADESANCIENTS-MUTUAL_DESTRUCTION.title: Mutual Destruction
HADESANCIENTS-MUTUAL_DESTRUCTION.descrip: Your Attacks deal [blue]{MoreDamageHighHp}%[/blue]/[blue]{MoreDamageMediumHp}%[/blue]/[blue]{MoreDamageLowHp}%[/blue] more damage, while your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThresholdHighHp}%[/blue]/[blue]{HpThresholdMediumHp}%[/blue]/[blue]{HpThresholdLowHp}%[/blue].
HADESANCIENTS-MUTUAL_DESTRUCTION.flavor: You're on the verge of yet another brush with death, I see, my hell-born kin. Do send some others down with you, would you?
HADESANCIENTS-PROFUSE_BLEEDING.title: Profuse Bleeding
HADESANCIENTS-PROFUSE_BLEEDING.descripti: At the start of each enemy's turn, it loses [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] HP for each unique debuff it has.
HADESANCIENTS-PROFUSE_BLEEDING.flavor: Perhaps the dead you stand against have long forgotten the experience of anguish and despair. I trust that you shall soon remind them for me?
HADESANCIENTS-RALLYING_CRY.title: Rallying Cry
HADESANCIENTS-RALLYING_CRY.description: At the end of each Elite combat, gain [blue]{GloryToGain}[/blue] [gold]Glory[/gold]. Start each combat with [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] for each [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Glory[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-RALLYING_CRY.flavor: May all the death you bring become the stuff of legends told in fearful mortal whisperings around the world, my kin.
HADESANCIENTS-SANGUINARY_SAVOR.title: Sanguinary Savor
HADESANCIENTS-SANGUINARY_SAVOR.descripti: You can now [gold]Pay Tribute[/gold] at Rest Sites.
HADESANCIENTS-SANGUINARY_SAVOR.flavor: Your sacrifice to me just now has moved me to forgiveness for the time; thus shall we call a truce.
HADESANCIENTS-STABBING_RUSH.title: Stabbing Rush
HADESANCIENTS-STABBING_RUSH.description: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]{CardsToExhaust}[/blue] {CardsToExhaust:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-STABBING_RUSH.flavor: There are so many types of death... and yet, the sudden, violent kind is unsurpassed, I think.
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_FLOURISH.title: Vicious Flourish
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_FLOURISH.descripti: Whenever you play a Skill card, apply [blue]{WoundsPower}[/blue] [gold]Wounds[/gold] to a random enemy.
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_FLOURISH.flavor: This world has a limitless capacity for pain; and so, it truly is no inconvenience to help you to bring out a little more.
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_STRIKE.title: Vicious Strike
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_STRIKE.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with [purple]Wounding[/purple].
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_STRIKE.flavor: I'd like to offer you a choice amongst my most exquisite tools which inflict suffering.
HADESANCIENTS-VISCERAL_IMPACT.title: Visceral Impact
HADESANCIENTS-VISCERAL_IMPACT.descriptio: At the start of each turn, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP. At the end of your first turn, your Form card is played for free.
HADESANCIENTS-VISCERAL_IMPACT.flavor: So much letting of blood, so much of it, your own. Let's see to keeping you alive and in the fight a while longer, then.
